8K STRONG IPTV FAQ

Frequently asked questions.

Clear answers about the service, activation, supported devices, setup and reseller access.

What is 8K Strong IPTV?

An internet-based streaming service for live channels, movies, series and sports through compatible players and devices.

Which devices are supported?

Smart TVs, Android TV, Fire TV, Apple devices, phones, tablets, computers, MAG boxes and compatible IPTV applications.

How quickly is access activated?

Access details are generally prepared shortly after payment and sent through your selected contact method.

What connection speed is recommended?

Around 10 Mbps can suit HD, while 4K usually benefits from 25 Mbps or more and a stable local connection.

Can I become a reseller?

Yes. Reseller packages provide credits and panel access for creating and managing customer subscriptions.
